en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a coastal urban scene with early 20th‑century buildings, some with balconies and a small towered structure in the center. In the foreground there is a wooden pier or boardwalk with simple railings. The background shows low-rise houses and a slightly elevated embankment. Greek and French captions are printed at the bottom, along with a website watermark.
